summary: Fixed-degree, growing-coefficient-height averages of Schinzel/Bateman–Horn prime values, followed by density-one local-to-global results for cyclic norm fibrations and diagonal conic bundles, and a >56% integral-point lower bound for x²+y²=f(t). The extraction is a substantive checkpoint: a direct counterexample to printed Lemma3.14 requires an archimedean/positivity repair before the analytic chain is executable. Generic class-field and quadratic-form suppliers are imported, not replanned. All inventoried missing items are routed, but original prerequisite proofs, fine decomposition and several source gaps remain open.

items.name: Fixed-degree coefficient box and height
